name: Restor
tagline: The operations backbone for multi-site dental groups and DSOs.
positioning: Restor unifies scheduling, clinical throughput, and revenue-cycle data across every location so DSO operators run their portfolio from one source of truth.

hero.h1: Run every operatory like your best-performing location.
hero.sub: Restor connects chair utilization, provider schedules, and revenue-cycle events across your entire portfolio — giving DSO leadership real-time control over 5 or 500 practices.

features.title: Chair utilization intelligence
features.description: See unbooked chair-time, provider idle gaps, and same-day cancellation exposure across every location, ranked by lost production dollars.

features.title: Portfolio-wide scheduling
features.description: Standardize appointment templates, hygiene recall cadences, and provider block schedules across acquisitions without touching each PMS.

features.title: Revenue cycle telemetry
features.description: Track claims from creation to remittance, flag aging A/R by payer, and surface denial patterns before they compound into write-offs.

features.title: Credentialing & compliance
features.description: Monitor provider licensure, DEA renewals, and payer enrollment status with automated escalation before any lapse blocks billing.

features.title: Integration layer
features.description: Bi-directional sync with Dentrix, Eaglesoft, and Open Dental keeps every practice management system reconciled in near real time.

features.title: Operator dashboards
features.description: Board-ready views of production, collections, and case acceptance by region, DSO cohort, and individual doctor — refreshed nightly.

testimonials.quote: Before Restor we reconciled 40 practices across three PMS platforms in spreadsheets. Now our regional VPs see chair utilization and A/R aging in one view every Monday morning.
testimonials.name: Danielle Prescott

testimonials.quote: The credentialing escalations alone paid for the platform. We eliminated three months of billing holds tied to lapsed payer enrollments across our Southeast group.
testimonials.name: Marcus Holloway

testimonials.quote: Restor gave our board the production-by-cohort reporting we needed to model integration timelines. Diligence on new acquisitions dropped from weeks to days.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramanathan

pricing.blurb: For emerging groups standardizing operations across their first locations.
For established DSOs scaling operations and revenue cycle at speed.
For national platforms with dedicated data and compliance requirements.

homepage.footerBlurb: Restor is the operations platform for multi-site dental organizations. One source of truth for every chair, provider, and claim.
